load_visual_entailment_dataset: load visual entailment dataset entries from SNLI-VE jsonl annotations for a given split
create_visual_entailment_dataset: create a VisualEntailmentDataset instance with tokenizer, image features reader, and bert model for visual entailment tasks
tokenize_hypothesis_sentences: tokenize hypothesis sentences with BERT tokenizer and pad to max sequence length
tensorize_dataset_entries: tensorize dataset entries converting token arrays and labels to PyTorch tensors
get_visual_entailment_item: get a visual entailment dataset item with image features, spatial boxes, and hypothesis tokens
